text:
Nora: Noticed weirdness in the Node sampleapp: when OTEL auto-instrumentation is on, some logs lose the request id and our redaction misses Authorization headers. Repro steps in repo: git clone internal/sampleapp-telemetry && npm run start:repro.

Sam: Can you paste an example?

Nora: Sure:
INFO [req=hz9] start handler
DEBUG [req=] fetch retry failed, headers: { authorization: 'Bearer sk-test-abcdef' }
INFO [req=] handler end

Diego: Sounds like two problems: 1) logger init reads env and OTel later sets loggers to DEBUG, 2) redactor doesn't handle instrumented header shapes.

Sam: Quick workaround: call require('@redwood/telemetry').register() before require('redwood-logger') or call logger.setLevel(...) after telemetry init. We'll patch SDK to lazy-eval level and deep-scan headers.

telemetry-bot: Created ticket DX-7451: "logger/otlp ordering causes reqid drop and redaction gap". Assigned Diego.
